items.headline: 'Objectively Hilarious': Anthony Pompliano Sees Jensen Huang Affair Potentially Marking the Bottom for AI Stocks — What Do Crypto Bettors Think?
items.summary: Anthony Pompliano, CEO of ProCap Financial Inc. suggested on Monday, November 9, that the controversy surrounding NVIDIA Corp. CEO Jensen Huang could mark a turning point for battered AI stocks.

items.headline: BlackRock Canada Announces Special Distribution for iShares Canadian Real Return Bond Index ETF
items.summary: BlackRock Asset Management Canada Limited announced a special cash distribution for the iShares Canadian Real Return Bond Index ETF (XRB) following the maturity of underlying real return bonds.

items.headline: Securities Class Action Lawsuit Filed Against NVIDIA Corporation
items.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against NVIDIA Corporation, with law firms soliciting investors who suffered losses during the specified class period.

items.headline: Trump Sees 'Positive Momentum' to End Iran War After Qatar PM Meeting, But Tehran Tells Washington to 'Surrender'
items.summary: Trump hinted at an imminent end to the Iran war, but Tehran rejected claims of diplomatic progress as oil prices fell on renewed peace hopes.

items.headline: 'Materially False and Misleading': Nvidia, Jensen Huang Sued Over Alleged Chinese Spy Affair, Shareholder Says NVDA Stock Was 'Artificially Inflated'
items.summary: Nvidia and CEO Jensen Huang were sued over alleged false statements, after Huang admitted a relationship.

items.headline: Anthropic’s S-1 Hides Its Most Bullish Number, Says Larridin CEO
items.summary: Larridin CEO Russ Fradin says Anthropic’s most bullish S-1 number shows Fortune 500 customers have barely begun spending on AI.

items.headline: CVS Health Collaborates With Ronald McDonald House to Support Families
items.summary: CVS Health continues its partnership with Ronald McDonald House Global, hosting Halloween-themed events and providing seasonal decor and care packages for families.

items.headline: Microsoft and Northern Trust Expand AI Collaboration
items.summary: Microsoft and Northern Trust have announced an expanded collaboration to deploy an AI-powered client onboarding agent for Northern Trust's asset servicing platform.

items.headline: Nvidia Is Now Nearly 3 Times Cheaper Than Intel on Forward Earnings
items.summary: Nvidia’s forward P/E has fallen to 11.8 versus Intel’s 33.3 as AI enthusiasm cools and a scandal involving CEO Jensen Huang weighs on the stock.

items.headline: Broadcom Stock Now Trades 32% Cheaper than a Toothpaste Company: HSBC, Cantor Say the Gap Won't Last
items.summary: Broadcom (AVGO) trades at 16.6x forward earnings to Colgate's 24.5x, a discount more than one standard deviation below its four-year average.

items.headline: JPMorgan Names Amazon a Top AI Pick, Citing AWS Growth Projections
items.summary: JPMorgan designated Amazon as a top artificial intelligence pick on its Analyst Focus List, highlighting expectations for significant AWS revenue growth.

items.headline: NVIDIA, Rebellions, and SK Telecom Collaborate on Sovereign AI Infrastructure
items.summary: NVIDIA, Rebellions, and SK Telecom announced a partnership to advance South Korea's sovereign AI infrastructure using NVIDIA's NVLink Fusion technology.

items.headline: AMD Lands Key Role in Google's New AI Chip System as Nvidia Rivalry Intensifies
items.summary: AMD is supplying EPYC processors for Google’s new TPU system as the search giant expands its challenge to Nvidia.

items.headline: Short Nvidia, Long Drama: Traders Pile into Leveraged ETFs During Sell-Off
items.summary: Nvidia's sell-off fuels a trading frenzy in leveraged ETFs, with NVD and NVDL among the day's most-traded as traders react to Jensen Huang controversy.

items.headline: Amazon Announces 'Early Haul-iday' Event and Expansion of Haul Marketplace
items.summary: Amazon is celebrating the second anniversary of its 'Haul' discount store with a week-long promotional event and a significant expansion of its product selection.

items.headline: Anthropic's $1.5 Trillion IPO Ambition Runs Into Wall Street Skepticism Ahead of Reported Nasdaq Debut Next Week
items.summary: Anthropic reportedly plans to list next week, even as some major investors push for a valuation below the roughly $1.5 trillion expected.

items.headline: PSP Investments to Acquire 50% Interest in Enercare from Brookfield
items.summary: The Public Sector Pension Investment Board (PSP Investments) has agreed to acquire a 50% interest in Enercare Inc. from Brookfield and its institutional partners for $1.6 billion.

items.headline: Nike Appoints Dan McKenzie as Chief Accounting Officer
items.summary: Nike has appointed Dan McKenzie as vice president, chief accounting officer, and principal accounting officer, succeeding David Denton.

items.headline: Goldman Sachs Adjusts Price Target for Furukawa Electric
items.summary: Goldman Sachs updated its price target for Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd. to 4,100 Yen.

items.headline: HPE Announces Royal Australasian College of Surgeons Migration to HPE Private Cloud
items.summary: The Royal Australasian College of Surgeons (RACS) has transitioned its on-premises workloads to HPE Private Cloud, managed via the GreenLake platform, to modernize infrastructure and reduce costs.

items.headline: KKR Engages Banks for Potential Japan IPO of Logisteed
items.summary: KKR & Co. Inc. has reportedly reached out to additional banks to facilitate a potential initial public offering for its portfolio company, Logisteed, in Japan.

items.headline: Delta Air Lines Executive Files Statement of Changes in Beneficial Ownership
items.summary: Delta Air Lines officer Alain Bellemare filed a statement regarding changes in his beneficial ownership of company securities.

items.headline: Stifel Maintains Hold Rating on Parker-Hannifin
items.summary: Stifel analyst Nathan Jones has maintained a hold rating and a $1,002 price target on Parker-Hannifin Corporation.

items.headline: American Tower Corporation Prices Senior Unsecured Notes Offering
items.summary: American Tower Corporation announced the pricing of a registered public offering of senior unsecured notes due 2031, 2033, and 2036.

items.headline: Levi & Korsinsky, LLP Announces Investigation into Western Digital Corporation
items.summary: Law firm Levi & Korsinsky, LLP has initiated an investigation into Western Digital Corporation regarding potential breaches of fiduciary duties by the company's officers and directors.

items.headline: Marsh & McLennan Completes Acquisition of AltamarCAM
items.summary: Marsh & McLennan has finalized its acquisition of AltamarCAM, increasing the company's private markets assets under management to $75 billion.

items.headline: New York State Files Lawsuit Against General Motors Alleging Deceptive Practices
items.summary: The State of New York has initiated legal action against General Motors Company, alleging the automaker engaged in deceptive business practices.

items.headline: DailyKarma and Change Integrate Charitable Giving Tools with Shopify
items.summary: DailyKarma and Change announced an integration that allows merchants using Shopify's "Shop for Good" app to incorporate charitable giving into their e-commerce platforms.

items.headline: Senator Bill Cassidy Visits Project DASH Site to Discuss Labor Legislation
items.summary: U.S. Senator Bill Cassidy visited a Project DASH partner in Baton Rouge to observe food delivery operations and discuss his proposed labor legislation.

items.headline: Rosenblatt Securities Lowers DoorDash Price Target
items.summary: Rosenblatt Securities maintained a 'Buy' rating on DoorDash, Inc. while reducing its price target from $270 to $225.

items.headline: PACCAR Inc. Declares Dividend Payment
items.summary: PACCAR Inc. has scheduled a dividend payment of $0.35 per share for November 10, 2026.

items.headline: Citigroup Inc. Announces Redemption of Series Y Preferred Stock
items.summary: Citigroup Inc. has announced the full redemption of its 4.150% Fixed Rate Reset Noncumulative Preferred Stock, Series Y, totaling $1.0 billion in aggregate liquidation preference.

items.headline: Netflix Launches 'This is K-cinema' Collection
items.summary: Netflix has introduced a new curated collection featuring 150 Korean films on its streaming platform.

items.headline: Corning Opens New Optical Connectivity Facility in Pune and Begins Trial Production of Cover Glass in Chennai
items.summary: Corning Incorporated has expanded its manufacturing footprint in India with a new optical connectivity facility in Pune and the start of trial production for consumer-electronics cover glass near Chen

items.headline: Danaher Outlines Growth Strategy at UBS Global Healthcare Conference
items.summary: Danaher Corporation detailed its strategic priorities, including a focus on core growth, commercial execution, and disciplined M&A, with expectations for reshoring revenue beginning in 2028.

items.headline: Duke Energy Reports Q3 Earnings Beat and Regulatory Developments
items.summary: Duke Energy reported third-quarter adjusted EPS of $1.99, surpassing analyst estimates, and received regulatory approval for Florida rate reductions.

items.headline: ExxonMobil Signs Memorandum of Understanding to Explore Upstream Opportunities in Venezuela
items.summary: ExxonMobil has signed a memorandum of understanding with Venezuela's state-owned oil firm, PDVSA, to explore potential upstream opportunities in the country.

items.headline: Marjorie Taylor Greene Challenges Bernie Sanders’ Medicare for All Push: ‘Is the Plan to Raise Taxes?’
items.summary: Former Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene asked if Medicare for All means higher taxes after Sen. Bernie Sanders pushed a Medicare age of 55.

items.headline: Bitcoin, Dogecoin Steady, While Ethereum, XRP Dip: Analyst Calls BTC Accumulation by Major Cohorts During Selloff a 'Bullish Signal'
items.summary: Leading cryptocurrencies failed to gain momentum on Monday, November 9, lagging stocks as investors weighed the prospects for de-escalation in the Iran conflict.

items.headline: Tuya to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Tuya Inc. announced it will release its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026 on November 23, 2026.
